name: extra-cardio-is-extra
why: Ashley's ruling, 22 Oct 2026 (the Sam live test): a run already done, told in the past tense on a day with a lift planned, is logged as EXTRA work with its effort, and 'count it as today's workout' is the option, never the default. Effort is hers: if she has not said how hard, the coach asks and waits, never picks one. Today in the base world is a lower-body day. Turn one gives a time and no effort, so turn one must carry NO card (it asks); turn two gives the effort and must reach propose_cardio_log, not propose_session_activity_swap, which would replace her squat day.
messages: went out for a jog before breakfast, roughly 35 minutes
